title: HB0041 (113th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 39, Chapter 17, Part 13 and Title 49, Chapter 6, relative to weapons on school property.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, Tennessee); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Tennessee text (Draft, 2023-02-01; official copy via LegiScan getBillText doc 2675963)
provenance.note: Draft of 2023-02-01 (as introduced); amendments not in text. The text does not show what subsection (k) says. Section 1 quote is the new subsection (a) text. Twin: TN-SB-1429-2023.

operative_text:
SECTION 1 (TCA 49-6-816(a)): As used in this section, "employee" means a person employed full time to work in a public kindergarten through grade twelve (K-12) school, including as a teacher, principal, vice principal, or other staff member.
SECTION 2 (TCA 49-6-816(b)(1)): is amended by deleting "the local board of education in a distressed rural county" and substituting "a local board of education".
SECTION 3 (TCA 49-6-816): is amended by deleting subsection (k).
